## Problem

Describe the specific maintenance or testing problem and link to the code involved.

## Goal

What should improve after this refactor?

## Proposed Changes

Outline the smallest change that addresses the problem.

## Acceptance Criteria

Describe the expected improvement and the existing behaviour or interfaces to preserve. List the tests or manual checks that will verify both.

## Out of Scope

What should this refactor intentionally avoid?

- New features
- Unrelated improvements
- Unnecessary dependency changes

## Additional Context (Optional)

Include related files, examples of duplication, existing tests, or relevant issues.
